title: RddfSessions
description: rddf-session lifecycle persistence for cross-opencode-session workflow recovery. Written by skills/_lib/rddf_session.py. See ADR-0017.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes. v2 adds optional sub_phase and workflow_group fields.

session_id.description: Unique session id, format rds_<12 hex chars>.

kind.description: Stage driver: arch / design / plan / ship (per v2.1 four-phase).

owner_opencode_session_id.description: OpenCode session ID that owns this rddf-session, or null after abandonment.

state.description: Lifecycle state. completed/failed/abandoned are terminal; orphaned→active allowed.

attached_changes.description: Changes attached to this rddf-session (set by guide-plan/guide-ship).

context_pointer.description: Path to handoff/state file for this session (e.g. .rddf/state/.arch-handoff.json).

end_reason.description: Why session ended (arch-done | plan-done | heartbeat-timeout | user-abandoned | gate-rejected | ...).

sub_phase.description: Optional sub-phase marker (e.g. 'phase_3_archive_demo'). Updated by hooks during long-running operations. v2: add-rddf-session-sub-phase-heartbeat.

workflow_group.description: Optional workflow group identifier linking related rddf-sessions. v2: add-rddf-session-workflow-group.
